businessGoal: Enable visitors to find specific products within a category through organized browsing.

scenarios.goal: Verify that clicking on a category name displays the correct category page and page title.
Verify that all filters available on the category page match those on the product overview.

manual.reason: The scenarios involve user interactions and visible outcomes on the UI.

api.reason: The scenario focuses on UI behavior that is not validated through an API.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria describe visible elements and interactions in the UI.
